title: 独立木质砧板

source.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: reusable transparent paper-theatre animation cutout. Primary request: one standalone rectangular wooden chopping board, for a Chinese home kitchen preparation scene. Subject: single flat beech-wood cutting board with softly rounded corners and one small handle notch, seen from a gentle top-down three-quarter angle; no food, no knife, no towel, no hands. Style/medium: refined tactile cut-paper collage with subtle paper grain and warm natural wood fibers, crisp silhouette, simple educational illustration. Composition/framing: one object centered and fully visible with generous transparent margin. Background: genuinely transparent alpha. Constraints: no background card, counter, cast shadow, glow, labels, logo, text, extra objects or watermark.

discovery.usage_notes: 独立承托层；食材和刀具另取，不能把它当作完整烹饪场景。

usage_notes: 可与现有蔬菜、鱼肉和厨刀组合；只提供承托关系，切配动作仍需当前镜头试装。
